title: Manim kit sample animations
intro: The kit's two sample animations as a slide deck: a scene file of boxes and lines, and a code scene.
site_intro: Each animation has its own page, with every step written out. Each unit also plays as a slide deck.

units.name: Scene files
units.lead: An animation described as boxes, lines and steps in a scene file.

slides.lead: A scene file is rendered once, then played in the deck.

units.name: Code scenes
units.lead: An animation written as Manim code, one block per step.

slides.lead: Twelve dots regroup three ways and the total stays the same.

words.deck_help: Use the bar at the bottom, or the arrow keys, to move between slides; the theme picker there switches every animation between light and dark. With reduced motion turned on in your system settings, each animation shows its steps as still frames.
words.own_page: This animation on its own page
words.also_home_html: Each animation also has a page of its own, listed on the home page.
words.credit_html: Rendered with Manim Community Edition (MIT licence). Set in Public Sans and JetBrains Mono, under the SIL Open Font License; the licence texts are in fonts/PublicSans-OFL.txt and fonts/JetBrainsMono-OFL.txt.
